name: Sakura Blade
description: A blossom-forged Attack type that reads repeated patterns, grows more dangerous after lost clashes, and cuts through exposed defenses with a decisive petal storm.

ability.name: Sakura Requiem
ability.description: Pattern Reader adapts against repeated enemy actions. Rising Stakes gains a stack only from lost clashes, up to 3; the next winning damaging action consumes all stacks for +3% damage each (maximum +9%). Mirror/draw results do not grant stacks.

special_move.name: Thousand Blossom Execution
special_move.description: Sakura Blade releases a decisive blossom storm for 170 base damage plus 50% of its Attack. Exposed Core can let the strike cut through a primed defense.
flavour_texts: 🌸 **Thousand Blossom Execution** — the battlefield disappears beneath a storm of petals!
